findings.title: Actual three-TP qualification omits native price/side/instrument validation
findings.cause: P1 held-frame validation checks native status/reduceOnly/owner ACK/no pending command and entitled leaves, then trusts method_a.coverage_ready. It does not check actual order instrument, exit side, finite positive price, distinct outward-positive ordered3TP geometry or bind price to authorized current TP/reference/actual ACK evidence. native_3TP can be PASS with quantities matching even when these required actual protection facts are not independently qualified. Exact a4 source and M1 support the implementation invariant, but a strategy-derived flag is not the independent native financial evidence required by this gate.

findings.title: Rights-complete gate overstates the performed oldSOL and parent-rights proof
findings.cause: rights_audit_complete is assigned PASS from profile_good and native_pairs. The only oldSOL-specific fill check (117–119) is membership of a level in the AFTER state rights set. It does not verify matching current parent, earned actual-entry fraction, raw legacy denominator/omitted-level crossing-session eligibility, authorized remaining SOL notional or irreversible consumption. For P0 the P1 entitlement checks are skipped entirely. Thus an existing rights set and complete fill snapshots can qualify rights_audit_complete while the contractually required parent/raw-right interface remains unmeasured.
findings.required_fix: Add a bounded actual/source-bound MethodA rights evidence gate with explicit raw/actual field mapping, parent/fraction/remaining-right/cross-session proof where required. When the frozen producer lacks a necessary fact, retain UNKNOWN and report the missing evidence; do not normalize unverified rights to PASS or substitute A0/paired rights. Empty actual opportunity must be explicitly distinguished from tested mechanism.
